result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make high-quality education—especially in critical thinking, empathy, and scientific literacy—freely and equitably available to every person.

Not because it would instantly solve everything, but because it would give people the tools to solve almost everything else: better institutions, healthier communities, more thoughtful innovation, and fewer conflicts driven by ignorance or manipulation.
